_comment: Every threshold the agent uses lives here so it can be reviewed and changed without code edits. See ARCHITECTURE.md for the reasoning behind each value.

goals._why_value: product value of reaching each goal: paid conversion 1.0; keeping a payer engaged 0.6; activation and re-engagement 0.5. Unmeasurable goals 0. A product owner should own these numbers.
goals._why_min_expected_value: below this the best goal is not worth an intervention (e.g. first paid plan only: value 1.0 x movability 0.02 = 0.02): the agent records it and leaves the default page
goals._why_scoring: score = value x 4p(1-p) x (0.5 if not actionable), p = organic baseline (baseline.py). The old paywall-intent bonus was removed: in the history, paywall viewers converted less (1.6%) than others (2.3%).

model._why: log_only: consulted on every new goal choice that has a real alternative, off the critical path; answers are validated and recorded but never followed. advise: follow validated answers (latency on the page path, shed under load). History: the call rule was first "within 0.2", widened to 0.5 after no injected faults fired (tuning toward the test), then replaced by log_only.

messaging._why: a follow-up message is only sent to viewers who are not already habitual (app open on at most 3 of the last 14 days); habitual viewers will see the page on their own
messaging._why_blast: runaway guard: messages whose send_at falls within one hour may not exceed max(blast_radius_max_per_hour, share x distinct viewers reached in the last 24 h); next-morning follow-ups are spread over morning_spread_min
messaging._why_followup: a follow-up is considered only for goals scoring >= 0.2; then each eligible viewer is assigned send or withhold at random (share 0.5, stable per viewer) so the message effect can be measured

baseline._why: null: fit the organic baseline from the pack (pilot holdout + history). A path: load a saved table instead, e.g. day 1's table updated with day 1's holdout outcomes (oua learn).
